name: drift
purpose: Dots that ride a path, as charge rides a wire. The speed can be a state key, so a slider changes the flow.
binds: speed: a number or a state key

on.doc: the id of the path that the dots ride

speed.doc: laps of the path in one second; a negative number turns the dots round; 0 stops them

size.doc: the size of a dot, in units of a thin line

show.doc: a state key; the dots show when its value is true

step.doc: the dots show from this step of the scene
